name: Ideal.iUnion_minimalPrimes
statement: ⋃ p ∈ I.minimalPrimes, p = { x | ∃ y ∉ I.radical, x * y ∈ I.radical }

name: Ideal.exists_mul_mem_of_mem_minimalPrimes
statement: Ideal R} (hp : p ∈ I.minimalPrimes) {x : R} (hx : x ∈ p) : ∃ y ∉ I, x * y ∈ I

have_tree.name: H
have_tree.type: ∃ m, x ^ m * y ^ n ∈ I

name: Ideal.exists_comap_eq_of_mem_minimalPrimes
statement: Ideal S} (f : R →+* S) (p) (H : p ∈ (I.comap f).minimalPrimes) : ∃ p' : Ideal S, p'.IsPrime ∧ I ≤ p' ∧ p'.comap f = p

name: Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_comap_eq
statement: Ideal S} (f : R →+* S) (p) (H : p ∈ (I.comap f).minimalPrimes) : ∃ p' ∈ I.minimalPrimes, Ideal.comap f p' = p

name: Ideal.minimalPrimes_comap_of_surjective
statement: R →+* S} (hf : Function.Surjective f) {I J : Ideal S} (h : J ∈ I.minimalPrimes) : J.comap f ∈ (I.comap f).minimalPrimes

name: IsLocalization.AtPrime.radical_map_of_mem_minimalPrimes
statement: Ideal R) [hqp : q.IsPrime] [IsLocalization.AtPrime A q] (I : Ideal R) (hIq : q ∈ I.minimalPrimes) : (I.map (algebraMap R A)).radical = q.map (algebraMap R A)
